San Francisco Superior Court Case Search: A Comprehensive Guide

The San Francisco Superior Court is responsible for handling various types of civil and criminal cases. If you need to search for a case in this court, you can do so by using the online portal or visiting the courthouse in person. In this article, we will provide you with a step-by-step guide on how to search for a case in the San Francisco Superior Court, along with some essential information about the court system and its procedures.

Overview of the San Francisco Superior Court

The San Francisco Superior Court is a trial court of general jurisdiction. It has the authority to handle both civil and criminal cases, including misdemeanors, felonies, small claims, traffic infractions, and civil lawsuits. The court operates in four locations across San Francisco: Civic Center Courthouse, Hall of Justice, Juvenile Justice Center, and Traffic Court.
